combined.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/whole_arm_first_pass/whole_arm_combined_cuff_k7.json

scope: Quasi-static virtual-work estimate for prescribed samples, nominal mass model and frictionless tension-only lines. Joints held quasi-static with zero velocity. Eight routed cable derivatives use prescribed interpolation. The two cuff cases add their independently solved 10 N couples. Contact reactions, joint stop reactions, TPU external loads and carriage force balance are outside the calculation. 10 N and 30 N are probe caps.
